subject: Nexodus Labs — Dedicated capacity demo and calendar coordination
messages:
From: Samira Patel <samira@nexodus.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 29 Jul 2028 16:15:00 +01:00
Subject: Redwood Dedicated trial signup — request to demo Dedicated capacity

Hi Marcus,

Thanks — I signed up this morning for a Dedicated capacity demo (via the trial flow). Our team at Nexodus Labs is evaluating solutions for inference at scale and we'd like to see Redwood's Dedicated offering focusing on throughput and p95 latency under sustained load.

Quick context: we're evaluating a chat-style workload with bulk batch inference peaks. Typical numbers: 120 concurrent requests, avg payload ~1,400 tokens, and target sustained throughput ~1,000 RPS during peak windows. We're especially interested in tail latency (p95) and the autoscale/burst behavior.

Can we schedule a 45-minute walkthrough next week? Our exec prefers mornings CEST (09:00–11:30). I included a short sample of our workload (csv) — it's sanitized: nexodus_p0_workload.csv.

Thanks,
Samira Patel
Head of ML Ops, Nexodus Labs
samira@nexodus.io

--

Date: Mon, 31 Jul 2028 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Dedicated trial signup — request to demo Dedicated capacity

Hi Samira — welcome, and thanks for signing up.

I can run the scheduling on our side. Quick options that work for our engineers this week (all in CEST):
  - Tue Aug 1, 10:00–10:45 CEST
  - Wed Aug 2, 09:00–09:45 CEST

If neither works, send a couple of windows and we'll do our best to match. For the walkthrough we'll bring a solutions engineer to cover the runtime/throughput details and an account rep for next steps.

Two quick clarifying items so we prep correctly:
  1) Do you expect the 1,000 RPS as sustained for >15 minutes or are those short bursts?
  2) Any constraints for load-testing (allowed source IPs, preferred test region, or blocked endpoints)?

I'll also drop our capacity checklist (short) so you can confirm the test plan.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
SDR, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai

From: Samira Patel <samira@nexodus.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Aug 2028 08:22:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Dedicated trial signup — request to demo Dedicated capacity

Thanks Ben — appreciate the quick reply.

Unfortunately Tue morning conflicts with our board meeting; Wed 09:00 CEST would work better for us (we have an exec at 09:15, so if possible 08:30–09:15 CEST would be ideal — apologies for the odd slot).

To clarify the workload: the 1,000 RPS is a sustained target during a 30–45 minute simulated load window (we intentionally stress-scale to see warm/cold LB behavior). Tail latency target: p95 < 200 ms end-to-end for the model path. We're open to running a smaller pilot first if you recommend it.

Allowed test sources: we'll provide a short list of CIDR ranges once you confirm a final slot. For the region, we'd like the demo in eu-west (Frankfurt preferred).

Looking forward — Samira

--
Samira Patel
Head of ML Ops, Nexodus Labs
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 2 Aug 2028 10:12:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Dedicated trial signup — request to demo Dedicated capacity

Hi Samira — Olga from Solutions Engineering here.

Thanks for the additional detail — this is helpful. I'm copying a short prep checklist below (and attaching the same as an xlsx). If we confirm Wed 08:30–09:15 CEST we'll use that slot and run a focused test in eu-west-1 with a staged ramp to your target.

Prep checklist (short):
  - Confirm final test CIDR ranges (we need IP allowlist for the load rigs).
  - Confirm model size (fp16/fp32) and KV cache behavior — do you use context caching between requests?
  - Provide sample payload sizes (you included avg tokens but can you provide 95th pct tokens per request?).
  - Point of contact in case we need quick infra changes during the run (name + cell).

Logistics:
  - We'll aim to validate sustained 1,000 RPS with incremental warmup (30m window). If we see cold-cache spikes we'll note mitigation options (batching, cache priming, autoscale config).
  - For the demo we'll use a non-prod model replica and synthetic traffic unless you prefer to run with the sanitized sample you attached.

Attached: dedicated-capacity-checklist.xlsx (same content as Ben's)

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.ai
